```python
import os
import tempfile
import shutil
from pyaedt import download_kit_files, generate_unique_project_name, is_ironpython
from pyaedt import Desktop, Hfss3dLayout
from pyaedt.generic.general_methods import check_and_download_file

# 1. Create a temporary folder and print its path.
temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
print("Temporary folder path:", temp_dir)

# 2. Download an example file into the temporary folder.
example_url = "https://github.com/pyansys/pyaedt-assets/raw/main/edb/ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb.tar.gz"
example_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, "ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb.tar.gz")
check_and_download_file(example_url, destination_folder=temp_dir)
# Extract the tar.gz file
import tarfile
with tarfile.open(example_file, "r:gz") as tar:
    tar.extractall(path=temp_dir)
aedb_folder = os.path.join(temp_dir, "ANSYS-HSD_V1.aedb")

# 3. Set the non-graphical mode and launches AEDT in graphical mode using SI units.
non_graphical = False
project_name = "example_project"
version = "2023.2"  # Change as needed

# 4. Initialize AEDT and launch HFSS 3D Layout.
d = Desktop(version, non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)
hfss3dl = Hfss3dLayout(projectname=None, specified_version=version, non_graphical=non_graphical)

# 5. If the AEDT file already exists, remove it and save the project in the temporary folder.
aedt_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, project_name + ".aedt")
if os.path.exists(aedt_file):
    os.remove(aedt_file)
hfss3dl.save_project(aedt_file)

# 6. Print the boundaries from the setups object.
if hasattr(hfss3dl, "setups") and hfss3dl.setups:
    print("Boundaries from setups object:", hfss3dl.setups[0].boundaries)
else:
    print("No setups or boundaries found.")

# 7. Hide all nets and then make only two specified nets visible.
net1 = "DQS0_T"
net2 = "DQ0"
hfss3dl.nets.hide_all_nets()
hfss3dl.nets[net1].is_visible = True
hfss3dl.nets[net2].is_visible = True

# 8. Plot the two specified nets.
hfss3dl.nets[net1].plot(show=True)
hfss3dl.nets[net2].plot(show=True)

# 9. Make all layers visible.
for layer in hfss3dl.stackup.layers.values():
    layer.is_visible = True

# 10. Change the color of a specified layer.
layer_name = "TOP"
if layer_name in hfss3dl.stackup.layers:
    hfss3dl.stackup.layers[layer_name].color = (255, 0, 0)  # Red

# 11. Disable the visibility of components for the top and bottom layers.
for comp in hfss3dl.components.values():
    if comp.layer in ["TOP", "BOTTOM"]:
        comp.is_visible = False

# 12. Fit all so that all can be visualized.
hfss3dl.fit_all()

# 13. Close the project and release the desktop.
hfss3dl.close_project(saveproject=False)
d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)

# Clean up temporary directory if desired
# shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)
```
